ai_summary: ## Executive Summary  Coforge Limited announced the launch of its AI-powered Vehicle Lifecycle Intelligence solution, designed to transform automotive inspections for lenders, fleet operators, and remarketing organizations. This innovation enables faster, more informed business decisions throughout the vehicle remarketing process by creating trusted digital condition reports. Materially, the solution is already operating at scale, supporting over 60,000 vehicles annually, reinforcing Coforge's "AI-native" leadership and demonstrating immediate market adoption. No red flags are apparent in this announcement.
